steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: County Hillock...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: A medium-sized nomadic city, a modest distance out from Londinium. Main pillars are agriculture and light industry, not on closest terms with the surrounding counties...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Full match to what the intel describes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Outcast, you there yet?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Just made it a minute ago. Did you slap a tracking device on me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've called you like fifteen times since last night!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I took the wasteland route. As if I'd have signal.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *Sigh*. Okay. Let me get this out there, I'm not the one in a rush. Misery's pushing it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You know how he is, the worrywart. Not my fault he can't chill out. He's all wound up, even out on a mission, it's like, is he looking to sprout some more wrinkles?!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: —Wouldn't be Misery if he was anybody else.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Fair enough. Seriously, though, any thoughts on the city?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Extremely normal.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Intel might be faulty, then? There's at least thirty, forty-ish cities in Victoria at that scale—

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No matter how bright the Londinium sun shines, there'll always be places its light can't reach.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You've seen the files. You should know County Hillock doesn't have any noble at the reins. Two counts showed interest in the city, but never saw it through.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Err... because it won't make any money?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Yeah, or because of how ordinary it is.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: But the more normal a place looks, the better it is to hide in plain sight. No matter when Rhodes Island decides to get moving, this is a good opportunity to scout the way ahead.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gotcha. Just call me if you need support. I only just geared up to head for Connor County. I'm still close by for now.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Resettling Infected's not easy work. I'm on basic chore duty compared to your mission, probably down at the branch office drinking tea more than half the time.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gimme a break. With a storm like this coming, is a Sankta like you gonna be happy chilling with a cup of tea?!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Ugh. You know, I'd love to live it up like a retiree.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wonder why I'm not convinced...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever, let's just all get our jobs done and head home soon as we can. Unrelated, Outcast, but I remember a bunch of green Sankta Operators waiting for you to hold marksmanship classes?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Relax, they need some free study time every now and then too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Also, and I know it goes without saying, but Misery won't get off my back about it—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Be careful, Outcast. Hope it all goes smooth.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Smooth?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hahah, sorry, kiddo, but that's not me.
6:50 A.M. \ Overcast
Interrogation Room, County Hillock of Victoria Barracks, outside corridor

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, it's so stuffy in here. There's no ventilation or nothin'.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You said the same during the Stockton serial bombing interrogation last year.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm not gonna be used to it, no matter how many times. You might call Cello instead. With her bein' over two meters, she could scare 'em into behavin' a bit.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You punching a clean hole through a steel table frightens suspects just as much.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aha, haha... I lost my head for a bit there. He took two children, and then he sat there bein' so sarky about their family. Didn't that steam you as well?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Was I steamed?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You left finger marks in his imprisonment device with how hard you squeezed round his neck. He pissed himself straight on the spot with the shock you gave him, spat his co-conspirator's name and the bomb coordinates right out, all shiverin'.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That was mostly your credit, wasn't it?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It was a necessary means of interrogation.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, I've never been good with those means. I passed basic interrogation theory by the skin of my teeth. Always copied my friends' homework, as well.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Then you're in luck. Our principal role today is sitting on the side, listening.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And thank goodness! Actually, um, it's almost time, isn't it? Why's nobody come to bring us in? Didn't that captain tell us it was goin' from 7 o'clock on?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's still four minutes to.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Excuse me, is Captain Kelly present? We're scheduled to meet him here.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I'm not sure.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Is there an interrogation set for seven?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Yesterday afternoon, we had a man suspected of smuggling illegal Originium goods. Do you know where he's being kept?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's three strikes...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Well, it wouldn't surprise me if County Hillock keeps slightly different time to Londinium.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh, is that a thing?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Seems at least to Captain Kelly it is.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Haha!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I suppose we'll just have to do as the locals do.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's ten minutes past now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Checking the time over and over won't bring our colleagues here any faster.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Perfect, in a way. I need to talk with you about that false alarm of a battle yesterday.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? Leader...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You aren't getting one past me. I'm asking you, when I gave the order to withdraw, why did you jump at that crate instead?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Weren't you yellin' for the others to withdraw?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Before we entered the warehouse, you ordered me to make sure to catch the suspect alive.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That was the initial order.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But orders are orders, right?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We all thought the suspect set off a bomb, didn't we? I judged that I was the only one with a chance to complete the mission.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If I could block the blast wave, I could keep the suspect alive, and you'd all be safe and sound too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Of course, I had no qualms about your shield, Leader... remember that time you saved me, under all that artillery fire? From the Sargon mercs? 'Cause I'll never forget that.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's... not what I'm talking about.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If, and I'm only supposing, there really was a bomb inside that crate, you would've taken grave harm. Possibly even thrown away your life.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh? No way. There weren't any explosives that high-spec in the stolen goods. Even if someone modified 'em secretly, the force wouldn't be any harder than the Fortcracker shells we use in combat exercises, y'know?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Heheh, I can take those.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't be overly reliant on Vouivran constitution in combat. How many times have I told you that?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Er... five?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ten at minimum, by my memory. And I can't imagine Slim didn't teach you that too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Might've... taught me that? Ha, haha...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Your smile-beaming has no effect on me. I'm your leader. I'm responsible for the safety of everyone under me.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm sorry, Leader...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You know what's coming after we return, don't you?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You can have me run laps, no problem... but I'd hate to go without supper.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There's times I have no idea how I should handle you, Bagpipe. You're the most outstanding soldier under my command. Your obstinance goes right along with your combat skills... constantly exceeding expectations.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well, it's got to be that way! My mum told me when I was little, 'Vouivre women must see things through to the end!'

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Not even a hurricane means much of anythin'. If you can't harvest all the wheat before it bogs down, your precious grains'll go all moldy!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I... was not singing your praises.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Forget it. No matter how much I scowl at you...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It'll be a miracle if it reforms you any.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Believe me, Leader, you've got a face far from scary... I've seen plenty enough of the sort with eyes all bright, tellin' people all sinister things with all the worst language Victoria has to offer!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Enough. Meaningless platitudes like this won't affect a qualified Victorian serviceman.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: You mean to say...?

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: This... does it have to be this way?

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Damian... no, I mean Barry. He was a good'un ever since he was young. I can guarantee, he simply took a wrong turn...

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: You're absolutely right.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: My apologies. Yes, I will follow orders.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Yes, those Londiniers are still here...

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Understood. I'll pass down the instruction, sir.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: My assurances. I never forget, I am first and foremost... a Victorian soldier.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, Leader, you're checkin' the clock again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm not like you. I can't go blank anywhere, anytime.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Honestly speakin', I've had that Feline from the warehouse on my mind. I still properly like the song he sang.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I imagined a bit, dunno why. That song would be lovely for singin' alongside tractorin'.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: 'The hibernatin' mountains carry livestock herds~'

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: He's starin' at me. Was I singin' out of tune?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You remembered the words wrong.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh! Wasn't it livestock? Was it buildin's, then? Or tillers?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You, Hillock pal over there, do you know what this song's words are meant to be?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You shouldn't be singing in here.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry. Did I violate any of your rules?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: At the very least, don't go singing that bunch's songs in front of us.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That bunch? What bunch? I don't get what you're sayin'.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Are you fiddling with me, Vouivre?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? What's got you angry now?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Bagpipe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Can't shake the feelin' somethin's off-kilter.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You can save it for later.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Uh, I'm not talkin' about... Leader, I think I just heard someone in there singin' as well!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You're right.
A matching tune comes from the depths of the dimmed corridor, of a deeper tone, rougher, broken off by a few fierce coughs from time to time.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You think the man's in there?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Hey, you're not allowed in!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oi! A—Are you the one we caught yesterday in the outskirt warehouse?

steps.name: Feeble Youth
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *pant*... D'you mean Damian? Poor Damian... got dragged off ages ago...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh?! When?! How'd we not hear?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Where did he get taken to?

steps.name: Feeble Youth
steps.text: Where... ha, haha... you're asking where...

steps.name: Feeble Youth
steps.text: He's already... already...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Or would you like to go the same way he went?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You're threatenin' him. Why? Where in the world did that man yesterday go to?

steps.name: Feeble Youth
steps.text: Ah... ha... went home.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Went... home?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: He got let go? So he had nothin' to do with the spectre force at all? Leader—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let me in...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You aren't allowed to converse with the prisoner without permission.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I want to see Captain Kelly. Step aside, soldier. I know he's in here.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: He is not.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You? You were the adjutant at the warehouse with the vile mouth, I remember you. What's your idea here?

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: The Captain left on urgent business. He asked me to pass this on to you—the interrogation ended one hour ago.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Gah...! So you mean, you went and gave us the wrong time?!

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: A lapse in communication. Not uncommon at all, is it?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What bloody lapse in communication... do you think we're idiots?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, they gave us false info, led us up the garden path!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's not the key point.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm asking you, soldier. Why did you show up to tell us this information now? Since you've bided so much time, surely none of you will mind us wasting even more.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: In regards to your question...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: (Muttered report)

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Thank you, acknowledged.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Lieutenant Skamandros, the order I received was to inform you of the following—

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Convict Damian Barry, your individual of utmost concern—was, ten minutes ago, in an attempt en route to seize weaponry from his escort and assault military personnel, shot dead.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What... what bloody nonsense are you feeding us?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We've seen that lad, he's just a normal man! He was frightened stiff when he saw us! How would he go attackin' a fully-armed regular by himself?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That is to say... you summarily executed the suspect without trial.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: I have relayed to you the facts.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, we've been put in the dark. Why wouldn't they let us have access to the suspect? Aren't we stood on the same side?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm still unclear about their reasons right now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The one thing I can be sure of is, if we want to continue investigating, we've only got ourselves to depend on. The attitude the barracks have is loud and clear—they won't be of any help to us whatsoever.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh. I'm not daft, either. I can see they've got a mean habit for trippin' people up.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So what do we do next? We scarcely got a lead, and it's gone again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We need to think of some other way.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, yeah! I just thought. That man called Damian, he said his work was sortin' the potatoes.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Every outer agriculture plate in a nomadic city has its own channel for transportin' crops inwards!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We should be able to find the farmworkers' settlement by followin' along. If we can have a chat with his friends or kin, we might find our lead again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's a very 'you' train of thought.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Then you just leave the information enquirin' to me!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Excellent. We begin immediately.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, are you gonna come with?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'll stay to negotiate with the barracks. To my mind, they wouldn't slop out an execution without going through interrogation. As long as they held one, there'll be records left behind.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Triangle?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Leader, we were in the outskirts—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You got ambushed?!

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: They came out of nowhere, and I got rumbled...

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: This lot's combat techniques and weaponry, they're a full match with previous intel... even Snare's Arts can barely hit them! Damn it!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Remember, your main duty is to come back alive!

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Acknowledged, Leader! We should be fine! Triangle, out—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: This is major intel. Our target, the force they call spectre-like, is in County Hillock this very moment.
